niches.title: Niches to search
niches.description: Which semiconductor niches to run. Each niche expands into a set of job-title search queries (see 'Custom queries' to override).

customQueries.title: Custom queries (override niches)
customQueries.description: If set, these job-title search strings are used instead of the niche presets. One search string per line.

sources.title: Job boards to use
sources.description: Which underlying Store scrapers to run. Google Jobs also aggregates ZipRecruiter, Dice and many ATS boards.

location.title: Location
location.description: City / state / region to search within, as you would type it on the job board. Leave blank for nationwide US (recommended for a broad net).

countryCode.title: Country
countryCode.description: ISO-2 country code that scopes the search domains.

datePosted.title: Only jobs posted within
datePosted.description: Recency window. For a daily schedule, keep this at 'Past 24 hours'.

maxJobsPerQueryPerSource.title: Max jobs per query per source (Indeed & LinkedIn)
maxJobsPerQueryPerSource.description: Cap on results pulled for each search string from Indeed and from LinkedIn. Lower = cheaper. ~60 is plenty for a 24h window on a niche.

googleMaxItems.title: Max jobs from Google Jobs (total)
googleMaxItems.description: Hard cap on total Google Jobs results across all queries for this run.

excludeStaffingAgencies.title: Exclude staffing / recruiting agencies
excludeStaffingAgencies.description: Drop postings where the hiring company name looks like a staffing firm, recruiter or consultancy (you are one — these are competitors, not clients).

extraExcludeCompanies.title: Extra company names to exclude
extraExcludeCompanies.description: Additional company-name substrings to filter out (case-insensitive), e.g. your own firm and known competitors.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Output only jobs not seen in previous runs
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: When ON, the dataset for this run contains only postings first seen today. When OFF, it contains every current match, each flagged is_new true/false. Keep OFF if the Google Sheet integration handles dedup.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (advisory)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Used only to log a projected-cost warning. It does not hard-stop the run — control spend with the max-jobs fields above and Apify's account limits.

googleSheetUrl.title: Google Sheet URL (optional, informational)
googleSheetUrl.description: Paste the URL of the Sheet you want rows appended to. Delivery is configured via the Apify → Google Sheets integration on this Actor/task (see README); this field is stored with the run for reference.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Passed through to the Google Jobs scraper. Residential proxy recommended.
